chunks: Allāh knows hidden matters and is aware of inner feelings. He encompasses everything. He has control over everything and power over everything.
ai.seo_question: What are the divine attributes of knowledge and power described in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s sermon on preparing for the Hereafter, Sharif al-Radi presents these attributes to underscore the necessity of sincere devotion, as God’s knowledge penetrates the deepest layers of the human soul (al-dhahir wa al-batin). This theological grounding serves as a spiritual motivator for believers to align their inner intentions with their outward actions, ensuring their deeds are accepted by the All-Encompassing Power.
